detail_request:
import os,json,hashlib,pathlib,re
base=pathlib.Path('/home/lizufan/riscv-lab/r5-firstdot-20261026-0056/runs/dot16-prefix-booth-20261108-main/local-01')
assert os.sched_getaffinity(0)=={3}
records=[]
def read(p):
 b=p.read_bytes()
 records.append({'path':str(p),'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()})
 return b
out=[]
for f,names in ((0,('_12383_','_11560_','_12363_')),(1,('_17980_','_17973_','_16905_'))):
 p=base/f'cost-feature{f}/mapped/mapped.v'
 v=read(p).decode()
 cells=[]
 for name in names:
  m=re.search(r'(?m)^  ([A-Za-z0-9_]+) '+re.escape(name)+r' \(\n(.*?)\n  \);',v,re.S)
  cells.append({'name':name,'cell_type':m.group(1) if m else None,'body':m.group(2) if m else None})
 s=read(base/f'cost-feature{f}/rtl/VDotCarrySaveRows.sv').decode()
 rows=[x.strip() for x in s.splitlines() if re.search(r'assign row[01] =',x)]
 out.append({'feature':f,'mapped_bytes':len(v),'cells':cells,'row_assignments':rows})
lib=pathlib.Path('/home/lizufan/riscv-tools/nangate45/NangateOpenCellLibrary_typical.lib')
b=read(lib)
assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()=='8d540a4d4cf6d09d27c87ad067857a9c0c2eeb023ab7a56e058cd3113db4e9b1'
s=b.decode()
areas={}
for name in ('DFF_X1','MUX2_X1','XOR2_X1','XNOR2_X1','AND2_X1','AOI21_X1'):
 m=re.search(r'cell\s*\(\s*'+re.escape(name)+r'\s*\)\s*\{',s)
 assert m,name
 a=re.search(r'\barea\s*:\s*([0-9.]+)',s[m.end():m.end()+2000])
 assert a,name
 areas[name]=float(a.group(1))
assert all(hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(r['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==r['sha256'] for r in records)
print(json.dumps({'records':records,'features':out,'library_cell_areas':areas,'unchanged_after':True},ensure_ascii=True))
